unit.why: A minimal memorate quoted from Keter Shem Tov: a soul tells the Besht that his revelations came from praying with great intention. It is embedded in a homiletic chain of quotations on prayer.
unit.boundary_note: Part of an anthology sequence of quotations on prayer; the neighbouring divisions are homiletic.

stories.start_quote: הנשמה אמרה להרב ר׳ ישראל בעש״ט
stories.summary_en: A soul tells the Baal Shem Tov that he was granted revelations of higher matters not for much Talmud and codes study but for always praying with great intention.
